```{r libraries}
source("R/helpers.R")
library(ggimage)
library(ggtext)
library(scales)
```

```{r load-pbp}
pbp_raw <- load_nhl_pbp(nhl_season)

# Regular season only (game_id digits 5-6 = "02"), and no shootouts: shootout
# attempts are not shots in any stat sense.
pbp <- pbp_raw %>%
  filter(substr(as.character(game_id), 5, 6) == "02",
         period_type != "SHOOTOUT")

thru_date <- max(as.Date(pbp$game_date))
thru_label <- str_squish(format(thru_date, "%B %e, %Y"))
n_games <- n_distinct(pbp$game_id)

# Shot attempts (Corsi). On BLOCKED_SHOT rows the NHL feed credits
# event_team_abbr to the BLOCKING team (event_player_1 is the shooter,
# event_player_2 the blocker), so flip it to the shooting team.
shots <- pbp %>%
  filter(event_type %in% c("GOAL", "SHOT", "MISSED_SHOT", "BLOCKED_SHOT")) %>%
  mutate(
    other_team = if_else(event_team_abbr == home_abbr, away_abbr, home_abbr),
    shoot_team = if_else(event_type == "BLOCKED_SHOT", other_team, event_team_abbr),
    def_team   = if_else(event_type == "BLOCKED_SHOT", event_team_abbr, other_team),
    is_goal = event_type == "GOAL",
    is_sog  = event_type %in% c("GOAL", "SHOT"),
    xg = coalesce(xg, 0),
    is_5v5 = strength_state == "5v5" & !coalesce(empty_net, FALSE)
  )

# For/against totals per team for a given set of shot rows.
team_totals <- function(df) {
  f <- df %>% group_by(team = shoot_team) %>%
    summarise(CF = n(), SF = sum(is_sog), GF = sum(is_goal), xGF = sum(xg))
  a <- df %>% group_by(team = def_team) %>%
    summarise(CA = n(), SA = sum(is_sog), GA = sum(is_goal), xGA = sum(xg))
  inner_join(f, a, by = "team")
}

# 5v5 time on ice. Each event's state holds until the next event (CHANGE
# events are in the feed, so the gaps are short); summing those gaps gives
# the 5v5 seconds per game, which both teams share.
toi_5v5 <- pbp %>%
  arrange(game_id, game_seconds, event_idx) %>%
  group_by(game_id) %>%
  mutate(dt = lead(game_seconds) - game_seconds) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dt), strength_state == "5v5") %>%
  summarise(toi = sum(dt) / 60, home = first(home_abbr), away = first(away_abbr),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(home, away), values_to = "team") %>%
  group_by(team) %>%
  summarise(toi_5v5 = sum(toi))

stats_all <- team_totals(shots) %>%
  left_join(nhl_teams, by = c("team" = "team_abbr"))

stats_5v5 <- team_totals(filter(shots, is_5v5)) %>%
  left_join(toi_5v5, by = "team") %>%
  mutate(
    xGF60 = xGF / toi_5v5 * 60,
    xGA60 = xGA / toi_5v5 * 60,
    CF_pct = CF / (CF + CA),
    GF_pct = GF / (GF + GA),
    sh_pct = GF / SF,
    sv_pct = 1 - GA / SA,
    PDO = 100 * (sh_pct + sv_pct)
  ) %>%
  left_join(nhl_teams, by = c("team" = "team_abbr"))

subtitle_base <- glue("{season_label} regular season | Thru games as of {thru_label}")
```

Team-level advanced stats for the `r season_label` NHL season, through `r n_games` regular-season games. Shot and expected-goal data come from NHL play-by-play via [fastRhockey](https://fastrhockey.sportsdataverse.org/), whose xG model scores every unblocked shot attempt.

***
## Expected Goals {.tabset}

Expected goals (xG) weight every unblocked shot by its probability of scoring, based on factors such as distance, angle and shot type. **xGF** is the quality of chances a team creates and **xGA** what it allows. Teams in the top-right quadrant create more than the league average and allow less. The diagonal lines mark equal expected-goal differential.

```{r xg-plot-fn}
xg_plot <- function(df, x, y, title, subtitle, xlab, ylab, tier_step) {
  mx <- mean(df[[x]]); my <- mean(df[[y]])
  rng <- range(c(df[[x]], df[[y]]))
  tiers <- seq(-10, 10) * tier_step
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]])) +
    # Lines of constant xGD (y = x - k). Drawn as segments in data space
    # because geom_abline's intercept does not follow scale_y_reverse.
    geom_segment(
      data = tibble(k = tiers),
      aes(x = rng[1] - 1, xend = rng[2] + 1,
          y = rng[1] - 1 - k, yend = rng[2] + 1 - k),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = my, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mx, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_image(aes(image = team_logo), size = 0.065, by = "width", asp = asp_ratio) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = range(df[[x]]) + c(-1, 1) * diff(range(df[[x]])) * 0.05,
                    ylim = range(df[[y]]) + c(-1, 1) * diff(range(df[[y]])) * 0.05) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, title = title, subtitle = subtitle,
         caption = caption_btp) +
    theme_custom() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1 / asp_ratio)
}
```

### 5v5 per 60

```{r xg-5v5}
xg_plot(stats_5v5, "xGF60", "xGA60",
        title = "5v5 Expected Goals per 60",
        subtitle = glue("xGF/60 vs. xGA/60 at 5-on-5 | {subtitle_base}"),
        xlab = "xGF/60 (higher is better)", ylab = "xGA/60 (lower is better)",
        tier_step = 0.25)
```

### All Situations

```{r xg-all}
xg_plot(stats_all, "xGF", "xGA",
        title = "Expected Goals, All Situations",
        subtitle = glue("Season xGF vs. xGA, all strengths | {subtitle_base}"),
        xlab = "xGF (higher is better)", ylab = "xGA (lower is better)",
        tier_step = 5)
```

## {-}

***
### Shot Share vs. Goal Share (5v5)

**Corsi For % (CF%)** is a team's share of all 5-on-5 shot attempts (goals, shots on goal, misses and blocked shots), the standard proxy for puck possession. **Goals For % (GF%)** is its share of 5-on-5 goals. Teams above the diagonal score a bigger share of the goals than their shot share suggests, through finishing, goaltending or luck. Teams below it are under-converting.

```{r cf-gf}
lims <- range(c(stats_5v5$CF_pct, stats_5v5$GF_pct)) + c(-0.02, 0.02)

ggplot(stats_5v5, aes(x = CF_pct, y = GF_pct)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_image(aes(image = team_logo), size = 0.065, by = "width", asp = asp_ratio) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = range(stats_5v5$CF_pct) + c(-0.01, 0.01),
                  ylim = range(stats_5v5$GF_pct) + c(-0.02, 0.02)) +
  labs(x = "5v5 Corsi For %", y = "5v5 Goals For %",
       title = "Shot Share vs. Goal Share",
       subtitle = glue("5-on-5 | Dotted line: GF% = CF% | {subtitle_base}"),
       caption = caption_btp) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1 / asp_ratio)
```

***
### 5v5 PDO

**PDO** is 5-on-5 shooting percentage plus save percentage (on shots on goal), times 100. The league as a whole sums to 100, and team PDO tends to regress toward it over a season, so a team far above 100 has probably been getting the bounces, and one far below has been unlucky.

```{r pdo, fig.height = 10}
pdo_df <- stats_5v5 %>%
  mutate(diff = PDO - 100,
         team = fct_reorder(team, PDO),
         label = sprintf("%.1f", PDO),
         logo_x = diff + if_else(diff >= 0, 0.35, -0.35))

ggplot(pdo_df, aes(x = diff, y = team)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = diff > 0), width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30") +
  geom_image(aes(x = logo_x, image = team_logo), size = 0.028, asp = 10 / 10) +
  geom_text(aes(x = logo_x + if_else(diff >= 0, 0.45, -0.45), label = label,
                hjust = if_else(diff >= 0, 0, 1)),
            family = "Outfit", size = 3.2, color = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#35b0ab", `FALSE` = "#d73027")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f", x + 100),
                     expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +
  labs(x = "5v5 PDO (Sh% + Sv%)", y = NULL,
       title = "5v5 PDO by Team",
       subtitle = glue("Above 100 = running hot, below 100 = running cold | {subtitle_base}"),
       caption = caption_btp) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
```

***
### Performance vs. Expectations

Each team's current points percentage compared with what the sportsbooks expected before the season. The preseason points over/under (from Hockey Reference) is turned into an implied points percentage by dividing it by the maximum possible points (2 × games in the season). Bars above zero mean a team is beating its preseason expectations.

```{r expectations}
# Preseason points O/U and Stanley Cup odds, from Hockey Reference before
# opening night. Team names match nhl_teams$team_name exactly.
preseason <- readr::read_csv("data/2026_preseason_odds.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(team_name = Team, cup_odds = `Stanley Cup Odds`, pts_ou = `Pts. O/U`)

# Games per team this season, from the schedule (not hardcoded: the NHL moved
# from 82 to 84 games).
season_sched <- load_nhl_schedule(nhl_season) %>% filter(game_type == "R")
games_per_team <- 2 * nrow(season_sched) / n_distinct(season_sched$home_team_abbr)

expect_df <- nhl_standings() %>%
  select(team_abbr, games_played, points, point_pctg) %>%
  inner_join(nhl_teams, by = "team_abbr") %>%
  inner_join(preseason, by = "team_name") %>%
  mutate(
    implied_pctg = pts_ou / (2 * games_per_team),
    diff = point_pctg - implied_pctg,
    team_name = fct_reorder(team_name, -diff)
  )

stopifnot(nrow(expect_df) == 32)  # a name mismatch would silently drop a team

ggplot(expect_df, aes(x = team_name, y = diff)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = team_color), width = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  geom_image(aes(image = team_logo), size = 0.03, by = "width", asp = asp_ratio) +
  # Sports-style points %: +.200, .000, -.100 (no leading zero).
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) ifelse(
                       abs(x) < 1e-9, ".000",
                       sub("^([+-])0\\.", "\\1.", sprintf("%+.3f", x))),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Points % over expected",
       title = "Performance Relative to Expectations",
       subtitle = glue("Actual points % vs. implied by preseason points over/under | {subtitle_base}"),
       caption = "Data: fastRhockey / Hockey Reference | Plot: @steodosescu") +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

***
### Average Home Attendance

Average attendance at each team's regular-season home games, as reported by ESPN. Neutral-site games, such as the Global Series, are excluded.

```{r attendance-data}
# ESPN's scoreboard is the only fastRhockey source with attendance, and its
# date-range form errors, so it is fetched one game date at a time. Finished
# dates are cached in data/attendance.csv (committed) so each refresh only
# fetches new dates. The last 3 dates are refetched in case ESPN revised them.
cache_path <- "data/attendance.csv"
cache <- if (file.exists(cache_path)) {
  readr::read_csv(cache_path, col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c")) %>%
    mutate(attendance = as.integer(attendance),
           neutral_site = as.logical(neutral_site))
} else {
  tibble(game_date = character(), game_id = character(), home_abbr = character(),
         venue = character(), neutral_site = logical(), attendance = integer())
}

schedule <- load_nhl_schedule(nhl_season)
final_dates <- schedule %>%
  filter(game_type == "R", game_state %in% c("OFF", "FINAL")) %>%
  distinct(game_date) %>%
  pull(game_date) %>%
  as.character() %>%
  sort()

to_fetch <- union(setdiff(final_dates, cache$game_date), tail(final_dates, 3))

fetch_day <- function(d) {
  sb <- tryCatch(
    suppressMessages(espn_nhl_scoreboard(dates = gsub("-", "", d))),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.data.frame(sb) || nrow(sb) == 0) return(NULL)
  sb %>%
    filter(season_type == 2, status_type_completed) %>%
    transmute(game_date = d, game_id = as.character(game_id),
              home_abbr = home_abbreviation, venue = venue_full_name,
              neutral_site = as.logical(neutral_site),
              attendance = as.integer(attendance))
}

fresh <- map(to_fetch, fetch_day) %>% compact() %>% bind_rows()

if (nrow(fresh) > 0) {
  cache <- cache %>%
    filter(!game_id %in% fresh$game_id) %>%
    bind_rows(fresh) %>%
    arrange(game_date, game_id)
  readr::write_csv(cache, cache_path)
}

attendance <- cache %>%
  filter(!neutral_site, !is.na(attendance), attendance > 0) %>%
  group_by(espn_abbr = home_abbr) %>%
  summarise(avg_att = mean(attendance), games = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(nhl_teams, by = "espn_abbr")
```

```{r attendance, fig.height = 10}
att_df <- attendance %>%
  mutate(team = fct_reorder(team_abbr, avg_att))

league_avg <- weighted.mean(att_df$avg_att, att_df$games)

ggplot(att_df, aes(x = avg_att, y = team)) +
  # League-average line sits under the bars so it doesn't cross the labels.
  geom_vline(xintercept = league_avg, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_col(fill = att_df$team_color, width = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_image(aes(x = avg_att + 650, image = team_logo), size = 0.028, asp = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = avg_att + 1350, label = comma(round(avg_att))),
            hjust = 0, family = "Outfit", size = 3.2, color = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "Average home attendance", y = NULL,
       title = "Average Home Attendance",
       subtitle = glue("Regular-season home games, neutral sites excluded | Dashed line: league average ({comma(round(league_avg))}) | {subtitle_base}"),
       caption = "Data: ESPN via fastRhockey | Plot: @steodosescu") +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
```
